items: A new creature for the mountains and glaciers: the frost wyrm, a wingless ice dragon with great swept-back horns, and its own area, the Frost cave: glacier ice, frozen falls, stunted firs and crystal-leaf trees
Its legend is the elder of all wyrms: aeons old, scarred, one horn broken, an icicle beard, its hoard frozen into its belly. It gives Wyrm's Glide: a longer blink
